author: Emene
text:
Yes, look at the chart below. The three first yellow candles are black. So bearish right? Not really. There are some buyers. You can tell by looking at the wicks. Doc explained that very well recently. It is strong buyers coming long into the market but progressively, otherwise price would shoot up and they would make less profits. Then you need to wait for some clear proof that bulls are really here before jumping the gun. The first green candle is a strong signal, you agree? Then, you can get in, and add to your winner if you see another confirmation of bulls' presence (second and third candles).

I hope it helped.

EDIT: Just so you know, and other readers too, we are not infallible: my first target was slightly higher and was not reached. The trades you saw yesterday all ended up at Break Even + a few after New York close.
